verdict.rationale: Codex is documented as a general-purpose coding agent that can inspect code, edit files, run commands, and automate repeatable work (codex-docs-8/9/19), which plausibly covers writing tests, fixing lint, and similar tasks, but no evidence explicitly confirms merge-conflict resolution or dependency updates. Community feedback is mixed, with some praising its real-world coding help ('no worse than average L3-L4 engs') and others reporting it struggles with tasks, so quality is inconsistent.
